page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 12 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached resources. Network capabilities include an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate stable performance across various workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1282.13 GB/sec, which drops to 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In database operations, the instance handles 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 8647.45 on PassMark database tests. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server processes 1294.61 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model, though performance scales down to 34.44 tokens per second for a medium 7B model.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the instance offers predictable compute performance without the overhead of shared-core architectures. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU hardware makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require high-speed local disk IOPS or hardware acceleration. It is well-suited for applications such as web serving, software compilation, database management, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
